records.text: Donors who attended the Aspen presentation told Candace Owens that Charlie Kirk never made the formal statement appointing Erika Kirk and that they believed the recording was AI-generated.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 4DvYXBn_5JI)

appearances.snippet: That's interesting because I have donors telling me that they are convinced that it is AI. They were there and Charlie never said this super formal statement. ... I appoint Erika Kirk if anything were to happen to me.

verification.notes: The statement relies on unnamed donors and concerns whether a private Aspen presentation contained a specific succession sentence and whether a recording was AI-generated. Live searches found the allegation repeated but no original full recording, authenticated source file, named attendee testimony, or forensic audio analysis. No conclusive source was available.
